title: pkpdsim: building blocks of physiologically based pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic models in SBML

creators.affiliation: Humboldt-University Berlin, Faculty of Life Science, Institute for Biology, Berlin; University Lübeck; University Hospital Schleswig-Holstein, Campus Lübeck, First Department of Medicine, Germany
creators.name: König, Matthias

description:
pkpdsim provides the building blocks shared by physiologically based pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic (PBPK/PD) models in SBML with source code available from https://github.com/matthiaskoenig/pkpdsim.

Features include

  • the creators and terms of use of a model
  • the annotations of recurring compartments
  • the collection of study data from the study folders of PK-DB
  • the initial values of a substance in every tissue of a model
  • the license texts of the COMBINE archive of a model

The documentation is available on https://matthiaskoenig.github.io/pkpdsim.

If you have any questions or issues please open an issue
